detail.title: Mechanical Accountability in WAKE Architecture
detail.summary: WAKE achieves accountability by bifurcating inquiry and verification. The governance module acts as an immutable arbiter that accepts or rejects research transitions based on adherence to strict, deterministic rules, preventing model-authored instructions from subverting research integrity.
detail.reason: Revising the study to incorporate the explicit governance mechanism (source-70c4dff141dd489d) and the scholarly context for bias (source-aff9418ec71a41c3).

detail.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models
detail.summary: By integrating the governance module's immutability as a fixed constraint, WAKE identifies its own boundary conditions as testable assumptions. Governance stability is maintained through the verifiable rejection of model-authored proposal transitions.
detail.reason: Revision of the assumption challenge notebook to incorporate updated source evidence and sharpen the findings on governance-constrained stability.
